differences: Text A makes the -1/-1 counter a cost of the optional choice (blight 1 on a creature you control) and creates the Treasure only if that counter is placed; Text B creates the Treasure first and then puts the -1/-1 counter after it, reversing the order of steps.
Text A requires the -1/-1 counter to go on a creature you control; Text B says 'a creature of your choice' with no controller restriction, so it allows a creature an opponent controls.
Text B's 'Otherwise, do nothing' branch and the unconditional counter step after it do not match Text A, where no creature means the blight cannot be done and no counter or Treasure happens.
